safety_designation: RESEARCH DEMONSTRATION PROTOTYPE — NOT FOR LIFE SAFETY

test_01_boundary_split.note: Gunshot split across chunk boundary was smoothly reconstituted by ring buffer and triggered 1 alert.

test_02_stream_start.note: Immediate gunshot at t=0.0s triggered upon completing initial analysis window buffer.

test_03_stream_end_cutoff.note: Incomplete truncated sub-window at stream termination cleanly preserved without throwing buffer exceptions.

test_04_extended_silence.note: 48.0s of continuous digital silence yielded 0 false alarms.

test_05_background_noise.note: Continuous background hiss yielded 0 false alarms.

test_06_clipped_input.note: Severe digital saturation successfully detected without numeric overflow.

test_07_corrupted_recovery.note: NaN/Inf corruption was sanitized, and detector immediately resumed valid alerting.

test_08_sample_rate_resampling.note: 48 kHz input audio automatically resampled to 16 kHz mono and accurately detected.

test_09_consecutive_double_taps.note: Rapid-fire double tap spaced past refractory decay produced exactly 2 discrete alerts.

test_10_reverb_duplicate_suppression.note: Long reverberant tail was merged into a single alert without duplicate false alarms.
